generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of self-service car wash (自助洗车场). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Create one open-sided self-service wash bay, photographed at a three-quarter angle along a single foam-covered car. Mount the retractable hose reel high on the wall and show the pressure washer wand connected to one foam cannon. A person may hold the wand beside the car, keeping the equipment visible. Arrange the shampoo bottle, wash mitt, wheel brush and drying towel separately on a small utility ledge; place the wet-and-dry vacuum near the rear wheel and run the grated drain diagonally through the foreground. Crisp daylight, wet concrete reflections, realistic foam, no duplicate bottles or brushes.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: pressure washer, foam cannon, car shampoo bottle, microfibre wash mitt, wheel brush, drying towel, wet-and-dry vacuum, wash-bay drain, retractable hose reel, soap-covered car.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
